description:
Activate Myr Battlesphere by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Myr Battlesphere
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four artifact tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Myr Battlesphere and another artifact, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
